events.label: Pinatubo eruption
events.explain: Volcanic dust warmed the stratosphere for about two years.

events.label: New microwave sounders enter MERRA-2
events.explain: The reanalysis started using a new satellite type. Jumps here can be the data source, not the atmosphere.

events.label: Aura satellite data enter MERRA-2
events.explain: Ozone and upper-level temperature inputs changed.

events.label: Hunga eruption water vapor
events.explain: An undersea volcano put a record amount of water vapor into the stratosphere, which cooled it for about two years.

datasets.label: MERRA-2 (NASA reanalysis)
datasets.note: A model blended with observations. Long record, but the satellites feeding it changed over time, which can create fake jumps high up.

variables.label: Air temperature
variables.explain: How warm the air is at that height.

variables.label: Water vapor
variables.explain: How much water vapor the air holds, compared with normal for that month.

variables.label: Ozone
variables.explain: How much ozone the air holds, compared with normal for that month.

datasets.label: AIRS (NASA Aqua satellite)
datasets.note: One instrument measuring from orbit since 2002. Shorter record, independent of the reanalysis model.

variables.label: Air temperature
variables.explain: How warm the air is at that height.
